newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - British budget economic forecasts.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - British budget economic forecasts.

text.p: Following is a selection of comments on the economic forecasts in Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown's budget statement on Wednesday. BRIAN HILLIARD, CHIEF ECONOMIST AT SOCIETE GENERALE
"(The forecast for) Consumer spending growth is sensible. Inflation perhaps a little bit optimistic."
GLENN DAVIES, CHIEF ECONOMIST AT CREDIT LYONNAIS --

"The consumer spending forecast of four percent for next year will worry the market a little bit. That's suggesting the consumer boom will continue. So I think that will suggest further base rate increases. He refers to stability in relation to our European partners. I wonder if that was a hint about the ERM (Exchange Rate Mechanism)."
